# Remediation plan · God's Eye View

Assessed 2026-10-23 by CrossCheck. Projected figures assume each wave's fixes land and are re-assessed.

## Where it stands

| Standard | Readiness | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| ISM + E8 | 42% | ISM and Essential Eight not met |
| ED-153 | 61% | SWAL claim not supported |

## Wave 1 · Must-fix

Closes items that block a claim on at least one standard.

- **W1.1** Start a hazard log (hazard, cause, effect, severity, mitigation, status) and a safety case that argues from it. (closes 30 in ED-153; 6 must-fix)
- **W1.2** Offer or enforce multi-factor authentication (TOTP, WebAuthn or the identity provider's MFA). (closes 2 in ISM + E8; 2 must-fix)
- **W1.3** Check permissions on every protected action (roles or policies), deny by default. (closes 2 in ISM + E8; 2 must-fix)
- **W1.4** Require sign-in for anything that is not meant to be public, using a maintained identity provider or library. (closes 1 in ISM + E8; 1 must-fix)

Projected after wave 1: ISM + E8 55% · ED-153 75% (projected)

## Wave 2 · Non-compliant

Closes items rated non-compliant.

- **W2.1** Log security-relevant events (sign-ins, permission changes, errors) in a structured, central log. (closes 2 in ISM + E8)
- **W2.2** Generate an SBOM (CycloneDX or SPDX) for each release. (closes 1 in ISM + E8)
- **W2.3** Document incident response: who is called, how incidents are triaged, contained and reviewed. (closes 1 in ISM + E8)

Projected after wave 2: ISM + E8 69% · ED-153 75% (projected)

## Wave 3 · Conditions

Lifts partial items to compliance.

- **W3.1** Run a static analysis security tool (CodeQL, Semgrep or similar) in CI and triage its findings. (closes 2 in ISM + E8)
- **W3.2** Replace eval, shell string execution and unsafe deserialisation with safe APIs; escape or sanitise HTML sinks. (closes 2 in ISM + E8)
- **W3.3** Use HTTPS for every external endpoint and enforce it (HSTS). (closes 1 in ISM + E8)
- **W3.4** Record what personal or sensitive data the software handles, where it is stored, and how long it is kept. (closes 1 in ISM + E8)

Projected after wave 3: ISM + E8 80% · ED-153 75% (projected)

## Wave 4 · Facts and review

Answers the questions code cannot, and the items a reviewer must judge.

- **W4.1** Reviewer assessment of the ED-153 items code cannot show (closes 4 in ED-153)
- **W4.2** Answer: Are its hosts hardened (unneeded services off, secure baseline applied)? (closes 2 in ISM + E8)
- **W4.3** Answer: Are its servers, operating systems and runtimes patched on a schedule? (closes 1 in ISM + E8)
- **W4.4** Answer: Do the hosts it runs on allow only approved programs to execute (application control)? (closes 1 in ISM + E8)
- **W4.5** Answer: Is its data backed up, and has a restore been tested? (closes 1 in ISM + E8)
- **W4.6** Reviewer assessment of the ISM + E8 items code cannot show (closes 1 in ISM + E8)
